headline: North Georgia stand alone as the last unbeaten side
dek: Flagler's unbeaten run ended away to Florida Southern, and North Georgia are now the only side in the conference without a defeat. They have won five and drawn five, conceding eleven goals along the way.
displaced_by: Flagler lost at Florida Southern; North Georgia are the only unbeaten side left

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: North Georgia's 22 goals are more than USC Aiken and Lander have scored between them, and nine different players have shared them.

wire.line: Flagler's unbeaten run is over; North Georgia, with five wins and five draws, are the last side yet to lose.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches have passed their date with no published result, among them Clayton State's visit to Oglethorpe and Middle Georgia State's to Columbia on 22 August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Middle Georgia State have conceded 29 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, while scoring eighteen.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Isaac Calderon has scored eight of North Georgia's 22 goals from 27 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Javier Gongora Andres has scored eight of Middle Georgia State's eighteen goals from 30 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Theo Hoang has scored seven of Georgia Southwestern's ten goals from thirteen shots.

last_match.line: Lander's first win away from home this season; Middle Georgia State have conceded more goals than any side in the conference.

next_match.line: Neither side has lost a conference match; Lander have scored in every one of theirs.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
